question: Should `agent-job.ts` permanently own lifecycle, agent-dedupe, and chat-dedupe terminal observations and all `agent.wait` waiter resolution?
rationale: This central ownership-boundary refactor carries a protected maintainer label, so permanent module ownership requires explicit lifecycle-owner intent even though no line-level defect was found.

options.title: Adopt canonical registry
options.body: Approve the single-owner boundary after directly inspectable runtime proof confirms the preserved terminal and collision invariants.

options.title: Retain narrower ownership
options.body: Keep some dedupe terminal projection separate if lifecycle owners do not want `agent-job.ts` to own all three observation sources.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical registry
recommendation.body: Approve the single-owner boundary after directly inspectable runtime proof confirms the preserved terminal and collision invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history trail covers the original dedupe waiter, sticky terminal protections, canonical outcome precedence, and affected Gateway integration.
